profile.name: Stepan Turchenko
profile.title: AI Generalist & AI Integration Specialist | Senior Fullstack Developer & Tech Lead
profile.summary: More than six years on heavy applications and the teams behind them, from a women-health startup in Delaware to retail and B2B products in Russia and agentic mobile work in Europe. I run things end to end: architecture, delivery, DevOps, hiring, and the reliability work - monitoring, alerts, and incident response - that keeps a product up under real load. I interview, negotiate, and ship in English, and I am as comfortable owning a roadmap as I am taking on a single hard problem. Right now most of my attention goes to bringing AI agents and automation into how companies actually operate.

achievements: AI agentic mobile app and backend services development
Achieved 99.9% system uptime by implementing robust DevOps practices and continuous monitoring solutions, clustering
Boosted user engagement by 40% by implementing new analytics features and refining UX/UI design elements
Led end-to-end development of 3 heavy services with an active user base
Mobile development, Fullstack Engineering, QA Automation
